documents.t: How Aixly works with Shopify
This page is general guidance to help you get started. It isn't legal advice, and other regions have their own rules. Please check your privacy policy with a legal professional.
Widget not showing on the storefront

Aixly adds an AI shopping assistant and live chat to your Shopify store, plus an inbox inside your Shopify admin. The AI assistant answers shoppers 24/7 using your live store data: products, prices, stock, your policies, store pages and the answers you teach it. It recommends products, checks order status for verified shoppers, and files order requests and returns. When a shopper needs a person, your team joins the chat live, from the app or from the team inbox with their own sign-in (no Shopify access needed), and can assign each chat to the right person. The assistant pauses while you're there and takes over again when you leave. The assistant keeps getting better: questions it couldn't answer, and answers your team gave in live chats, appear in Teach the assistant for one-click approval.

A chat button (launcher) on your storefront in your colors and style, and/or a chat window embedded in a page A chat window where they can: ask about products and get product cards with Add to cart check their order status (after verifying it's their order) request a cancellation, change, return or refund chat with your team, see when you're typing, and send photos or PDFs Previews of new messages from your team above the chat button, even after they've closed the chat A short rating question ("How was your chat with …?") after a live chat An email with your reply and a Continue the chat link, if they left before you answered and shared their email Shoppers always see that they're chatting with an AI assistant. The chat follows your store's language (or the shopper's browser, or one language you choose) with everything built in for 28 languages (including right-to-left Arabic and Hebrew), and your own texts can be translated in one click. The assistant replies in the language the shopper writes in.

Dashboard: setup guide, Aixly impact (sales influenced, share handled by the assistant, satisfaction), where shoppers find the chat, chat activity and recent chats Analytics: trends, engagement funnel, revenue attribution, usage Chats: the live inbox, and Teach the assistant Requests: order requests and returns captured in chat Appearance: widget design, chat button, popups, cart reminder, quick actions Settings: assistant behavior, order lookup, knowledge base, live chat, team, helpdesk, languages, notifications, privacy Plans: your plan and usage Support: help center, contact options, and privacy & EU compliance guidance

Online / Away: click your status on the Chats page to stop offering live chat while you're away from an open tab Live chat: if nobody joins within 5 minutes, the assistant takes over again (10 minutes once someone has joined) Chats in the Shopify admin: the same compact layout as the team inbox, so the conversation gets the space Emails from Aixly have a new look, and new stores get a welcome email with the setup steps

Team inbox: invite staff to answer chats with their own sign-in, no Shopify access needed (agent and manager roles) Helpdesk connections: tickets in Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout or any system via webhook Languages: choose the chat language (store, browser or fixed), translate every text with AI help, reword all hand-off lines Phones: the page behind the chat no longer scrolls or shows through above the keyboard

Live chat Real-time live chat: messages, typing indicators and team joins appear instantly See what a shopper is typing before they send it Previews of your latest messages above the chat button when the shopper has closed the chat Missed replies are emailed to shoppers with a Continue the chat link Sound and in-app alerts on any page, plus email/Slack reminders when a shopper waits 3 minutes Photos and PDFs in both directions (JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF up to 5 MB) Live chat satisfaction ratings Inbox Suggest reply: an AI draft of your reply that you edit before sending Saved replies with the / shortcut and {first_name} Tags and a tag filter Orders placed after chatting shown on the conversation Smarter assistant Saved answers and Correct this answer apply from the very next message Teach the assistant: answers your team gives in live chats are suggested for your knowledge base Returns filed directly in Shopify from the chat Sales Aixly impact on the Dashboard, with stricter attribution (only shoppers who actually used the chat) Cart reminder with an optional discount code Storefront Embedded chat window: a theme block that puts the chat inside any page section Open the chat from your own buttons (data-aixly-open) or JavaScript events (aixly:open) Shoppers always see that they're chatting with an AI assistant Dashboard and support "Where shoppers find the chat" overview with copyable links and code Chat activity (visitors, chats, AI replies) with trends vs the previous period, and recent chats with automatic tags New Support page with privacy and EU compliance guidance Widget and admin Icon size control and custom launcher icons The Appearance preview shows the real widget, including the chat button Mobile: full-screen chat without page scrolling behind it Simpler installation using Shopify's standard flow (no extra redirects)

documents.t: The top of your Dashboard shows the last 30 days: Sales influenced: revenue and orders from shoppers who used Aixly before buying (see below) Conversations Handled by the assistant: the share of conversations resolved without your team Live chat satisfaction: the share of 4–5 star ratings, the average and the number of ratings

An order counts as influenced by Aixly when, within 7 days before the order, the shopper: chatted with the assistant or your team, or clicked or added a product to their cart from the chat, or used the cart reminder. Logged-in customers are matched even if they order on another device. Simply opening the chat window doesn't count. Influenced orders also appear on the shopper's conversation in Chats.

In the app, open Analytics: Conversations and trends Escalations to your team Engagement funnel (widget loads → opens → messages → product clicks → add to cart → checkout) Influenced orders, revenue and average order value, per day Top products shown, clicked, added to cart and purchased Usage charges (if your plan has overage billing)

Many conversations but few product clicks: add quick actions for bestsellers, and make your greeting invite product questions. Many escalations about the same topic: answer it once in Teach the assistant. Low satisfaction: read the comments on low ratings in Chats, and set up saved replies for consistent answers.

In the app, open Appearance The preview on the right runs the real storefront widget with your unsaved settings, so what you see is exactly what shoppers get. Click Save settings when you're happy. Changes reach your storefront within a couple of minutes.

Give each conversation an owner so the right person answers it, and nobody answers twice.

Open the conversation in Chats (or in the team inbox) and click Assign at the top. Choose: Store admin: anyone using Aixly in your Shopify admin Any team member with access to your store (their photo or initials, and their role, are shown) Unassign to give it back to everyone Anyone with inbox access can assign, both the store and team members. Reassign a chat any time, for example to a manager who knows your returns policy.
When you reply to, or join, a chat that nobody owns, it's assigned to you automatically. A chat that already belongs to a teammate stays theirs.
documents.s: Chats you reply to become yours

documents.t: Mine (next to Needs reply) lists the open chats assigned to you. In the list, a chat shows Yours, or → name for a teammate's.

When a teammate assigns a chat to you: you hear the alert sound and see a notification while the inbox is open team members also get an email with an Open the chat link that goes straight to the conversation
Pausing or removing a team member (Settings → Team) gives their chats back to everyone, so nothing gets stuck with a person who can't answer.
In the app, open Chats. It has two tabs: Inbox and Teach the assistant. Everything updates live: new messages, shoppers typing, and takeovers by teammates.

Needs reply: shoppers waiting for your team, and live chats with unread messages Mine: open chats assigned to you Live: chats your team is in right now All and Closed Search messages, email or name Tags: filter by a tag you added Each row shows the latest message (or "Typing…"), the status, who it's assigned to, tags and the shopper's rating.

The full conversation, including what the assistant said and the products it showed The shopper's contact details (if they shared them), whether they're logged in, and orders they placed after chatting A summary for your team when a shopper asked for a person Join chat, Hand back to AI, Assign (to yourself, a teammate or the store admin; see Assigning chats), Close / Reopen Tags: add tags such as refund or vip with + Tag (up to 10) Correct this answer under any assistant reply (see Knowledge base and teaching the assistant)
See Live chat for typing previews, Suggest reply, saved replies and attachments.
Questions the assistant couldn't answer and answers your team gave, ready to save to your knowledge base. See Knowledge base and teaching the assistant.
Keep Needs reply empty: those shoppers are waiting. Use tags to spot patterns (for example how many chats are about shipping-delay). Save your most common replies as saved replies.

Without any setup, the assistant reads: Your catalog, live: products, prices, variants and stock are checked at the moment a shopper asks, so they're never out of date Your policies: refund, shipping, privacy, terms and contact policies from Shopify Your store pages: published pages are read automatically, and re-read whenever you create or edit a page The knowledge base is where you add everything else.
In the app, open Settings → Knowledge base training
FAQ pages, sizing guides, care instructions, store locations and similar. Only pages on your own store domain can be added.

Short question-and-answer pairs for answers you want to control exactly. These are used from the very next message: If a shopper asks the same question (ignoring capitals and punctuation), the assistant replies with your answer word for word. If they ask it differently or in another language, the assistant uses your answer as the correct one, ahead of anything else it knows or said earlier in the chat. If you save the same question again, the newest answer wins.
PDF, DOC, DOCX or TXT (up to 5 MB), for example manuals and size charts. Each source shows its status (queued, processing, trained or failed). If something fails, fix the source and add it again.

This list collects what's worth teaching, most frequent first: Questions the assistant couldn't answer from your store information, and answers shoppers rated as not helpful Answers your team gave in live chats that would help other shoppers (shipping, policies, product details). The team's answer is filled in for you; personal details and order numbers are removed. If it disagrees with an answer you already saved, both are shown so you can choose. Click Answer or Review & save, adjust the text, and save. Nothing is added to your knowledge base without your approval.
documents.s: Teach the assistant (Chats → Teach the assistant)

documents.t: In any conversation (Chats), every assistant reply has Correct this answer. Edit the answer and save it: the assistant uses it from the next message on. tip Spend five minutes a week in Teach the assistant. It's the fastest way to make answers more accurate.
In the app, open Settings → Languages

The language the shopper is browsing your store in (recommended): follows your store's languages in Shopify (Markets, Translate & Adapt). A shopper on your French storefront gets the chat in French. The shopper's browser language: useful if your store is in one language but your shoppers aren't. Always one language: pick it from the list. Whatever you choose, the assistant answers in the language the shopper writes in. Built in for 28 languages: buttons, forms, the AI notice and every system line ("our team is joining", "you're chatting with the assistant again"…). Europe English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian Asia & Middle East Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew Arabic and Hebrew chats are laid out right to left.
documents.s: Which language does the chat use?

documents.t: Set Your texts are written in to the language you type your texts in. Then, under Translations, click Translate next to a language. Languages you've translated are listed first; click Show all 28 languages (and use the finder) for the rest. Every text shoppers can see is listed (chat title, greeting, AI notice, live-chat lines, quick actions, popups, cart reminder), with your original under each field. Fill empty fields with AI drafts the translations for you. Placeholders like {code} and {name} stay as they are. Review, then Save translations, then save the page. Preview shows the chat in that language. Empty fields use your original text, except system lines, which use the built-in translation for that language.

In Settings → Live chat & handoff you can reword: Message when the team is joining / offline When a team member joins ({name} becomes the team member's or your team's name) When the chat goes back to the assistant When nobody from the team could join The AI notice under the chat header is in Appearance → Window. It's always shown (shoppers must be able to tell they're chatting with an AI), but you can word it your way.

A shopper is handed to your team when they: ask for a person (for example "Can I talk to someone?"), or use one of your escalation keywords (for example chargeback, lawyer, allergic reaction). The assistant summarizes the conversation for you and tells the shopper someone will join shortly. If your team is offline (outside business hours, or nobody has the app open), the shopper leaves their email or phone instead, and you'll find the request in Chats.

Let shoppers chat with your team: turn live chat on or off Team name shown to shoppers: for example "Store team" or "Ana" Message when the team is joining and Message when the team is offline Escalation keywords: comma-separated Only offer live chat during business hours: set your hours per day and Time zone Email shoppers the replies they missed: see below Your team counts as available while someone has the app open in Shopify admin (any page) or the team inbox open.

The badge next to the inbox tabs shows your status. Click it to switch: Online: shoppers who ask for a person are offered live chat while you have the app open. Away: having the app open doesn't offer shoppers live chat. Use it when you step away and leave the tab open. Teammates who are online can still take chats. Saved per browser. Offline: live chat is off, or it's outside your business hours. Shoppers leave their email or phone instead. Change this in Settings → Live chat & handoff.

In the app: a sound and a notification on any page when a shopper is waiting or writes in a live chat. Turn the sound on or off with Sound alerts on the Chats page (saved per browser). Email / Slack: right away when a shopper asks for a person, and a reminder if a shopper has waited 3 minutes without a reply (once per wait). Set the recipients in Settings → Notification settings.

Open the conversation in Chats and reply. Sending a reply joins the chat and pauses the assistant (you can also click Join chat). See what the shopper is typing before they send it, live The shopper sees when you're typing Suggest reply (✨): the assistant drafts a reply as your team, using your products, the shopper's order and your saved answers. Edit it, then send. Nothing is sent automatically. Saved replies: insert one from the list, or type / in the reply box (for example /ship). {first_name} is filled in with the shopper's name when they shared it. Attach photos or PDFs (up to 3 per message, 5 MB each)

Click Hand back to AI when you're done, or Close the conversation. The shopper is then asked to rate the chat (1–5 stars); the rating appears on the conversation and in Aixly impact on your dashboard. If nobody from the team replies, the assistant takes over again so the shopper is never stuck: Nobody joined within 5 minutes of the hand-off (your team gets a reminder at 3 minutes). Someone joined but hasn't replied or typed for 10 minutes. The shopper then sees: "Our team couldn't join right now, so the assistant will keep helping. Leave your email or phone if you'd like the team to follow up." The note stays in the conversation history. If you reply afterwards, the chat is live with your team again. Change the wording in Settings → Live chat & handoff.

If you reply after the shopper has left the store and they gave their email in the chat, Aixly emails them your reply with a Continue the chat link. The link reopens the same conversation on any device and expires after 14 days. Turn this off with Email shoppers the replies they missed.

When a shopper wants to change something about an order, the assistant first verifies it's their order (order number plus email or phone, or automatically for logged-in customers), then records the request for your team: Cancel an order Change an order (address, items, …) Return, refund or exchange

With Settings → Order lookup → File return requests in Shopify on (the default): The assistant lists the items on the order that can still be returned. The shopper chooses the items, quantities and the reason (for example "too small" or "arrived damaged"). A return request is created in Shopify → Orders → Returns, with the reason and the shopper's own words. You approve or decline it in Shopify, and Shopify emails the shopper the next steps (for example a return label). The request also appears in Requests with a Return … in Shopify badge. If an item can't be returned yet (for example the order hasn't shipped), the assistant explains that instead. If Shopify can't create the return for another reason, the request comes to Requests as usual, so nothing is lost. note Filing returns needs Shopify's returns permission. If you installed Aixly before this feature, Shopify asks you to approve it the next time you open the app.
In the app, open Requests: Filter by type and status Update the status: New, In progress, Resolved or Rejected View chat opens the conversation the request came from
In the app, open Plans

Every plan has the full assistant: product answers, order tracking, add to cart, live chat, the team inbox and all languages. Plans differ in how many conversations the AI handles each month and how many team members you can invite. Live chat between your team and shoppers is unlimited on every plan. Plan Price AI conversations a month Extra conversations Monthly limit on extras Team members Free $0 50 none: the AI pauses none 1 Lite $9.99 120 $0.10 each $50 2 Basic $19.99 350 $0.08 each $100 3 Growth $49.99 1,000 $0.06 each $200 5 Pro $99.99 2,500 $0.05 each $300 10 Scale $199.99 5,000 $0.04 each $500 Unlimited Paid plans include a 7-day free trial and remove the small "Powered by Aixly" label from the chat. Not sure which plan fits? The plan calculator on aixly.io works it out from your monthly AI conversations and team size, including what extra conversations would cost.

An AI conversation is one shopper the AI helps within 24 hours. A shopper who sends 20 messages in that time still counts once. These are never counted: Chats that only your team answers (live chat) The chat's "talk to the team" form Questions the AI turns away as unrelated to your store Answers where the AI found nothing in your store

Free plan: the AI pauses until your plan renews. The chat stays on your store: shoppers get a form to reach your team, and live chat keeps working. Paid plans: the AI keeps answering, and each extra conversation is billed at your plan's rate. Shopify asks you to approve a monthly limit on these extras when you choose the plan. If that limit is reached, the AI pauses until your plan renews, so you're never charged more than you approved. Extra charges appear in Shopify Admin → Settings → Billing and on the app's Analytics page.
documents.s: When you reach your plan's conversations

documents.t: The trial is once per store. If you change plans during the trial, you keep the days you have left. You can cancel any time from the Plans page (switch to Free) or by uninstalling the app.

Change your plan any time from the Plans page. Shopify asks you to confirm a paid plan on its own billing page. Switching to Free cancels the paid subscription right away. If you have more team members than a smaller plan includes, everyone stays on the team, but you can't invite anyone new until you're under the limit.
If our prices change later, your plan keeps the price and limits you signed up with for as long as the app stays installed. If you uninstall and install again, you get the plans offered at that time.
Your Plans page shows how many AI conversations you've used this month and the date your plan renews. Counts reset on that date each month.
In the app, open Appearance → Popups The preview shows the popup you're editing.

Greeting on load: a friendly prompt shortly after the page loads Idle popup: a prompt when the shopper hasn't interacted for a while Promotion popup: an offer or announcement Popups never cover new messages from your team: message previews always take priority. Best practice: keep popups short and helpful, and don't overdo promotions.
Invite shoppers to chat after they've been browsing for a while: Enable Proactive prompt Set Show after (seconds) (recommended: 20–40) Optionally show it only once per session

Recover carts with a gentle reminder, optionally with a discount code. When it shows: The shopper has items in their cart, and they stay on the cart page for the time you set, or (on desktop) move to leave your store Settings: Remind shoppers about their cart: turn it on Message: your text. Use {code} to include the discount code. Discount code (optional): an existing code from Shopify → Discounts. Shoppers apply it with one Apply code click (it's added to their cart through Shopify's own discount link). On the cart page after (seconds): 10–300 Show again after (days): 1–30 The reminder never appears while the chat is open or during a live chat. Orders placed after a shopper uses the reminder count toward Aixly impact on your dashboard. tip Create a dedicated code for the reminder (for example CART10) so you can see in Shopify how often it's used.

Quick actions are buttons in the chat, above the message box, that help shoppers start common tasks with one tap. Examples: "Track my order" "Size guide" "Talk to a person" On phones they sit in one row that shoppers can swipe; on larger screens they wrap onto extra lines. They're hidden while your team is chatting live.
In the app, open Appearance → Quick actions (up to 6)

Send a message: posts a message into the chat and the assistant answers. Best for "Return policy", "Show bestsellers", "Talk to a person". Open a link: opens a page you choose. Best for your account page, contact page or a booking page. Order status form: shows a secure form for the order number and email/phone, then the order status. Best for "Track my order".
In the app, open Settings
Chat with your assistant right inside Settings. It works exactly like the live widget but doesn't count toward your conversation quota, and it never creates real requests or returns.

Shoppers must prove an order is theirs before seeing its details. Choose what they enter together with the order number: Email only Phone only Email or phone Logged-in customers are recognized automatically and can see their recent orders without entering anything. Repeated wrong guesses are blocked. File return requests in Shopify: when on, a verified shopper picks the items and the reason in the chat, and a return request appears in Shopify → Orders → Returns for you to approve or decline (Shopify then emails them the next steps). When off, returns arrive in Requests like other order requests. See Order requests and returns.
See Knowledge base and teaching the assistant.
Suggest a specific link when shoppers ask about a topic, for example "Book a test ride" → your booking page.

Formal or conversational tone Short or detailed answers Humor and emoji use Assistant name Your own instructions (brand voice, things to always mention) Your instructions shape the tone, but they can't make the assistant invent prices, stock or policies: those always come from your store.
See Live chat. All the lines shoppers see during a hand-off can be reworded here.
Invite people to the team inbox. See Team inbox.
Create tickets in Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout or any system. See Integrations → Helpdesk.
See Languages.
Topics the assistant should politely decline (for example competitors or medical advice).
Hide on the cart page Hide on these pages: paths starting with /, such as /pages/contact (subpages are included)
Keep conversations forever, or delete them automatically after 30 days to 2 years. Shared files are deleted with them.
Notification email and Slack incoming webhook URL for alerts: a shopper asked for a person, a shopper has been waiting for a few minutes, or you're nearing your plan's limit
You can use any of these at the same time; they all share the same conversation. The Dashboard → Where shoppers find the chat card shows what's live, and has the links and code below ready to copy.
documents.s: Adding the chat to your store

documents.t: The main way to add Aixly: a chat button in the corner of every page, with optional popups and the cart reminder. Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot → Save, or click Turn on on the Dashboard. Design it in Appearance; hide it on specific pages in Settings → Where the chat appears.

Put the chat, always open, inside a page: product pages, a support or FAQ page, a landing page. Click Place on product page on the Dashboard, or in the theme editor choose Add block → Apps → Aixly chat window in any section. Set the Height and Maximum width in the block settings. Save. On pages with a chat window the floating button is hidden, so shoppers see one chat. The window shows even on pages where you've hidden the floating button.

Use these in buttons, menus, emails or social posts (replace the domain with yours): Link What it does https://your-store.com/?aixly_open=1 Opens the chat https://your-store.com/?aixly=Where%20is%20my%20order%3F Opens the chat and asks the question Message text must be URL-encoded (spaces as %20, ? as %3F). The parameter is removed from the address bar after the chat opens.
Add data-aixly-open to any link or button, for example in a Custom Liquid section: Ask about shipping With a value, the chat opens and asks that question.

For developers: open, close or toggle the chat from your own scripts. window.dispatchEvent(new Event('aixly:open')); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('aixly:open', { detail: { message: 'Where is my order?' } })); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('aixly:close')); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('aixly:toggle')); These need the floating chat button or a chat window on the page.
Your team can answer chats from any browser with their own sign-in. They don't need a Shopify account or access to your Shopify admin.

Open Settings → Team. Enter their email, choose a role and click Send invitation. Agent: answers and assigns chats. Manager: also teaches the assistant (Teach the assistant, Correct this answer) and sees unanswered questions. They open the link in the email (valid for 7 days, works once), enter their name and choose a password. How many people you can invite depends on your plan: Free 1, Lite 2, Basic 3, Growth 5, Pro 10, Scale unlimited. If you move to a smaller plan, everyone stays on the team, but you can't invite anyone new until you're under the limit. See Plans and billing. If email isn't set up for your store yet, the invitation link is shown so you can send it yourself with Copy link. Lost the email? Click New link next to the invitation (the old link stops working).

The team inbox is at app.aixly.io/team. It's the same live inbox as in the app: typing previews, suggested replies, saved replies, tags, files and alerts. The top bar shows the store and your role. People who help several stores switch between them there. Inbox and Teach the assistant (managers) are at the top left; Sound on/off at the top right. Forgot your password? on the sign-in page sends a reset link (valid for 1 hour). Resetting signs you out everywhere else.

Click your name or photo at the top right. Edit profile: your photo and your name (what your teammates see). Change password: enter your current password and a new one (10+ characters, with a number or symbol). Other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in. Sign out Photos can be JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. They're shown next to chats assigned to you.
Give each chat an owner. Anyone on the team can assign a chat to a teammate or to the store admin, and replying claims a chat nobody owns. See Assigning chats.

In Settings → Team: Make manager / Make agent changes the role. Pause stops access right away; Restore gives it back. Remove takes them off your team (their account stays for other stores they help). Paused or removed people's chats go back to everyone.

By default replies are signed with your team name. Turn on Show each team member's first name to shoppers in Settings → Live chat & handoff to sign replies from the team inbox with the person's first name.
Passwords are stored as strong one-way hashes, repeated wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes, invitation and reset links work once, and access is checked on every request.

The chat widget helps shoppers: Find products: the assistant searches your live catalog and shows product cards with price, availability and an Add to cart button (with an option picker for products with variants) Get answers: shipping, returns, warranty, sizing and anything in your policies, store pages and knowledge base Check orders: status and tracking, after proving it's their order (logged-in customers are recognized automatically) Request changes: cancellations, changes, returns and refunds (returns can be filed directly in Shopify) Reach your team: live chat with your staff when they need a person

Turn it on/off: Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot (or add the Aixly chat window block to a page; see Adding the chat to your store) Design and popups: Appearance Assistant behavior, live chat, where it appears: Settings

Clearly an AI: a short note under the header tells shoppers they're chatting with an AI assistant (and that they can ask for a person when live chat is on). Fast, streamed answers in the shopper's language. The interface is available in 28 languages (see Languages), right to left for Arabic and Hebrew. Photos and PDFs: shoppers can attach up to 3 files per message (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB each), for example a photo of a damaged item. The assistant can look at photos. Files are checked for safety, and only the shopper and your team can open them. Live chat: when your team joins, the header shows "You're chatting with …", the shopper sees when you're typing, and replies arrive instantly. New-message previews: if the chat is closed when your team replies, the latest messages (up to 3) appear above the chat button with an unread count. They stay until the shopper opens the chat, even across pages. Rating: when your team leaves a live chat, the shopper is asked "How was your chat with …?" (1–5 stars, with an optional comment for low ratings). Email follow-up: if the shopper left before you replied and shared their email, they get your reply by email with a Continue the chat link that reopens the same conversation on any device. You can turn this off in Settings → Live chat & handoff. Mobile: the chat opens full screen, the page behind it doesn't scroll, and the keyboard never covers the message box. While the shopper types, the chat turns compact (smaller header; quick actions and the AI note step aside) so more of the conversation stays visible above the keyboard.

Each shopper only ever sees their own conversation. Order details are shown only after verification. You decide how long conversations are kept (Settings → Chat history retention). Shopify's customer data requests and deletions are handled automatically.
Open Appearance Set colors, the chat button (shape, size, icon or your own logo), greeting and quick actions The preview on the right shows exactly what shoppers will see Click Save settings

Open Settings → Knowledge base training Add your FAQ, sizing and care pages, documents (size guides, manuals) and short question-and-answer pairs Your published store pages and policies are already read automatically

Open Settings → Live chat & handoff Choose the team name shoppers see, your business hours, and keywords that should always reach a person (for example chargeback or allergic reaction) In Settings → Notification settings, add the email (and optionally a Slack webhook) for alerts when a shopper is waiting

Open Settings → Order lookup Require the email, the phone, or either one, together with the order number. Logged-in customers don't need to enter anything. Decide whether returns are filed directly in Shopify (File return requests in Shopify)
documents.s: 4) Choose how shoppers prove an order is theirs

documents.t: Use Settings → Try your bot, or open your storefront in a private window and ask: "What's your return policy?" "Do you have this in size M?" "Where is my order?" "Can I talk to a person?" (then reply from Chats)

Check Chats → Teach the assistant every few days and save answers for questions the assistant couldn't handle Use Correct this answer under any assistant reply in a conversation to fix it from the very next message

Install Aixly from the Shopify App Store and approve the permissions Shopify shows you. The app opens inside Shopify Admin → Apps → Aixly. There's nothing else to connect: the app sets itself up the first time it opens. When an update needs new permissions Shopify asks you to approve them the next time you open the app after the update. Until you do, only the features that need them (for example, filing returns in Shopify) stay off. Everything else keeps working.

Open Dashboard. The Setup Guide walks you through: AI processing: your store pages and policies are read so the assistant can answer questions about them. This usually takes a minute or two. Products, prices and stock are always read live. Turn on the widget: opens your theme editor Check it's live: confirms the chat button appears on your storefront Try your bot and choose a plan
In Shopify admin: Go to Online Store → Themes Click Customize Open App embeds Enable Aixly AI Chatbot Click Save
documents.s: 3) Turn on the chat widget (theme app embed)

documents.t: Open your storefront: the chat button should appear (usually bottom right). If it doesn't, go back to Dashboard and click Refresh status in the Setup Guide. Still nothing? See Troubleshooting → Common issues.

Already use a helpdesk? Aixly can create a ticket there when your team needs to follow up. Each ticket has the AI summary, the shopper's request, their contact details, the chat transcript and a link to the conversation in Aixly.
documents.s: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)

documents.t: Open Settings → Helpdesk, pick your helpdesk and fill in: Helpdesk You need Where to find it Zendesk Subdomain, agent email, API token Admin Center → Apps and integrations → Zendesk API Freshdesk Subdomain, API key Profile picture → Profile settings → View API key Gorgias Subdomain, account email, API key Settings → REST API Help Scout App ID, App secret, Mailbox ID Your profile → My Apps → Create app; the mailbox ID is in the mailbox URL Webhook An https URL (optional signing secret) Zapier, Make or your own system Click Connect, then Send a test ticket to check it works. The test ticket opens in a new tab.

Choose any of: A shopper leaves their contact details because your team is offline A shopper asks to cancel, change or return an order A shopper waits 3 minutes in a live chat without a reply If your helpdesk is briefly unavailable, Aixly retries automatically (over about 16 hours). Recent tickets shows each one with a link, and Retry for any that failed.

Each ticket is sent as JSON (event: aixly.ticket.contact, aixly.ticket.order or aixly.ticket.unanswered) with the subject, text, contact details, summary, transcript and conversation link. If you set a signing secret, verify requests with the X-Aixly-Timestamp and X-Aixly-Signature headers: the signature is sha256= followed by the HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body, using your secret.
Credentials are stored encrypted and are only visible to the store (never to team-inbox members). Disconnecting stops new tickets.

Aixly uses Shopify's standard installation: you approve permissions on Shopify's own screen, and when an update needs a new permission, Shopify asks you the next time you open the app. Aixly asks for: Permission Used for Products Live product answers, product cards, add to cart Orders Order status for verified shoppers, order requests, sales attribution Customers Recognizing logged-in customers and their orders Returns Filing return requests from the chat (Shopify → Orders → Returns) Legal policies, online store pages Answering questions about your policies and store pages Themes Checking that the chat widget is turned on in your theme
The widget is added with a theme app embed, so your theme code isn't changed: Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot. Turning the embed off removes the widget.
Through a secure Shopify app proxy, the widget knows when a customer is logged in, so they can see their own recent orders without typing an order number or email.

Orders: new orders are matched to recent chats for Aixly impact. No customer contact details are stored for this. Returns: return requests are created in Shopify for you to approve or decline. See Order requests and returns. Discounts: the cart reminder applies an existing discount code from Shopify → Discounts. Aixly never creates or changes discounts.
Plans are charged through Shopify billing. Usage charges (if your plan has them) appear in Shopify Admin → Settings → Billing.
Shopify's customer data requests and deletion requests (GDPR) are handled automatically, and uninstalling the app removes your store's data after Shopify's required waiting period.
Not legal advice This page is general guidance to help you get started. It isn't legal advice, and other regions have their own rules. Please check your privacy policy with a legal professional.

AI is always recognizable. The chat shows shoppers "You're chatting with an AI assistant" in their language, as the EU AI Act's transparency rules require. When your team joins, the chat says so. Order details only after verification. Shoppers prove an order is theirs (order number plus email or phone, or being logged in) before seeing it. Retention you control. Choose how long conversations and shared files are kept in Settings → Chat history retention. Data requests handled. Shopify's customer data and deletion requests (GDPR) are processed automatically, and your store's data is removed after you uninstall. Analytics consent. Analytics events follow your store's cookie consent (Shopify Customer Privacy).
documents.s: What Aixly already does for you

documents.t: Mention the chat in your privacy policy (template below). Pick a retention period that matches your policy (Settings → Chat history retention). If you have staff in the chat, make sure they know conversations are stored and visible to your team.

Adapt this to your store and add it to your privacy policy (Settings → Policies in Shopify admin): Chat assistant. Our website offers a chat, provided by Aixly, where you can ask questions about our products, your orders and our policies. Answers are generated by an AI assistant; members of our team may also reply. We process the messages you send, any files you attach, and contact details you choose to share (such as your email address or phone number) in order to answer your questions, help with your orders and improve our service. If you're logged in, we use your customer account to show your own orders. Chat conversations are stored for [retention period] and then deleted. The AI responses are generated using OpenAI as a sub-processor. You can ask us to access or delete your chat data at any time by contacting us at [your contact email].

The chat stores small items in the shopper's browser to keep their conversation across pages, which is needed for the chat to work. Analytics events respect your store's existing cookie consent banner. If you're unsure, ask your legal advisor.
documents.s: Do I need a cookie banner for the chat?

documents.t: Check the embed is on: Shopify admin → Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → enable Aixly AI Chatbot → Save. Make sure you're editing your published theme. Check the Setup Guide: app → Dashboard → Refresh status. Check Appearance: app → Appearance → Button → Show launcher is on. Check where it appears: app → Settings → Where the chat appears. It may be hidden on the cart page or on paths you listed. Wait and refresh: changes can take up to 2 minutes to reach your storefront.
documents.s: Widget not showing on the storefront

documents.t: Check that the Aixly app embed is still turned on in your theme (Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds) and that the launcher isn't turned off in Appearance. Running out of AI conversations doesn't hide the chat: the AI pauses and shoppers get a form to reach your team.

Shopify asks for new permissions when you open the app after an update. Approve them on Shopify's screen. If you dismissed it, reload the app from Shopify Admin → Apps → Aixly. Features that need a missing permission (for example filing returns in Shopify) simply stay off until then.
documents.s: The app keeps asking me to approve permissions, or a feature says it needs permission

documents.t: Settings → Live chat & handoff: Let shoppers chat with your team must be on. If Only offer live chat during business hours is on, check the hours and Time zone. Someone needs to have the app open in Shopify admin (any page) for the team to count as available. Otherwise shoppers leave their contact details instead, and you'll find the request in Chats.
documents.s: Shoppers can't reach my team / live chat isn't offered

documents.t: Check Settings → Notification settings: the notification email is correct. Look in your spam folder, and add the sender to your contacts. For instant alerts while you work, keep the app open; turn on Sound alerts on the Chats page.

Missed-reply emails are only sent when the shopper left before your reply and shared their email in the chat, and Email shoppers the replies they missed is on. They're sent about 2 minutes after your reply.
documents.s: A shopper didn't get my reply by email

documents.t: URLs: use pages on your own store domain with readable text (not mostly images). Documents: PDF, DOC, DOCX or TXT, up to 5 MB.

Open Chats → Teach the assistant and save answers for the questions listed there. Use Correct this answer on wrong replies in Chats: the fix applies from the next message. Add your FAQ, shipping and sizing pages in Settings → Knowledge base training. Check Settings → Personality instructions don't contradict your policies.

The shopper needs the order number and the email or phone used on that order. Settings → Order lookup decides which one proves the order is theirs. Logged-in customers don't need either. Only orders from the last 60 days can be looked up. Test with a real order from your store, using the exact email on the order. If the assistant says order information is unavailable for every order, contact us from Support → Ask Aixly → Email our team so we can check your store.
documents.s: Order tracking can't find an order

documents.t: Settings → Order lookup → File return requests in Shopify must be on, and the returns permission approved. Only items that have been fulfilled and not already returned can be returned. Otherwise the assistant explains this, or the request goes to Requests.
documents.s: A return wasn't created in Shopify
